title: Von-Taube-Weg, Gauting
description:
Room Description

Welcome to this bright and comfortable private room located on Von-Taube-Weg in Gauting, one of the most desirable residential areas in the southwest of Munich. The room offers thoughtfully furnished living space and is ideal for students, interns, young professionals, and commuters looking for a peaceful yet well-connected home.

The room is equipped with a comfortable bed, a spacious wardrobe, and a practical desk, providing the perfect setup for both relaxation and productivity. The apartment itself spans approximately 90 m2 and is shared with two friendly housemates, creating a welcoming and international living atmosphere. High-speed WiFi and central heating are included.

Common Areas

Residents have access to:

• A well-maintained bathroom
• A separate toilet
• A fully equipped kitchen with all essential appliances
• A washing machine for shared use

Location & Transport

The apartment enjoys an excellent location in Gauting, offering a quiet residential setting with convenient access to Munich and the surrounding region.

Nearby public transport options include:

• Gauting S-Bahn Station (S6) – approx. 12–15 minutes walking distance
• Bus stops with connections to the S-Bahn station and neighboring districts – approx. 3–5 minutes walking distance

Travel times by public transport:

• Munich Central Station (Hauptbahnhof) – approx. 25 minutes via S6
• Marienplatz – approx. 30 minutes
• Starnberg – approx. 10 minutes
• Planegg – approx. 5 minutes
• LMU & TUM city campuses – approx. 35–40 minutes
• Munich Airport – approx. 60 minutes

Neighborhood

Gauting is known for its green surroundings, high quality of life, and excellent infrastructure. Within walking distance you will find:

• Gauting town center with cafés, bakeries, restaurants, and supermarkets
• Several parks and walking trails
• Local sports and fitness facilities
• Pharmacies, banks, and everyday services
• Beautiful forest and nature areas ideal for jogging, cycling, and outdoor activities

The nearby Würm River and surrounding green spaces provide a unique balance between nature and urban accessibility, making Gauting particularly popular among professionals working in Munich who appreciate a quieter living environment.

title: Münchner Straße, Starnberg
description:
Wake up in Starnberg with the lake practically as your neighbor. In the morning, it’s the kind of place where you can grab a coffee, step outside, and be by Lake Starnberg within minutes—whether you’re going for a calm walk along the shore, a quick jog, or simply a deep breath of fresh air before the day begins.

Back at the apartment, everything feels easy and practical—yet cozy. There’s a separate bedroom for restful nights, and in the living room a double sofa bed that comfortably sleeps two more guests, making the space ideal for up to 4 people. The dining area invites slow breakfasts and relaxed dinners—perfect after a day out exploring, working remotely, or visiting nearby Munich.

One of the loveliest corners of the home is the winter balcony (enclosed balcony / winter garden)—bright, peaceful, and usable year-round. It’s the perfect spot to read, journal, enjoy your morning tea, or just unwind while the day softens outside.

The kitchen is fully equipped for everyday cooking, whether you’re preparing something simple or putting together a proper meal. And the bathroom is clean and comfortable—everything you need, without fuss.

And then there’s the location: you’re not only close to the lake, you’re also just a few meters from supermarkets and essentials, so you can arrive, settle in, and feel at home immediately—no car required, no complicated planning. Just a smooth, convenient stay with nature and city comfort side by side.
